items.title: Define canonical document views and fail-closed content selectors
items.context: Create a data-only registry with stable view identities, canonical versus legacy-fallback provenance, managed-slot and legacy-complement selectors, disjoint-range validation, host selectors, and no filesystem I/O.

items.title: Register and secure thin-entrypoint process-evidence artifacts
items.context: Add exact typed artifact templates, ambiguity-rejecting resolution, descriptor-bound no-follow I/O, current-active signer authorization, pending-key preflight separation, and private-key provider/bootstrap behavior required by the plan.

items.title: Add red-before and green-after thin-entrypoint failure exercises
items.context: Build the required temporary-repository/in-memory harness for budgets, imports, links, provenance, selector states, freshness, typed paths, signatures, key rotation, provider recovery, symlink and TOCTOU boundaries, material cleanliness, and frozen legacy-root rejection; record assertion-specific red evidence before production behavior is changed.

items.title: Integrate focused verification without migrating existing consumers
items.context: Register the failure-exercise smoke in focused commands and npm test, build the package, and prove the new isolated registry/validator infrastructure passes while audit, review, templates, and root entrypoints retain their current behavior until later Stories.
